Big drone, big jobs

DJI's smart agricultural equipment — spraying and spreading drones built to cover large fields quickly and evenly.

Tanks from 20 L to 100 L

Across the range, spray tanks run from 20 L on the T25 to 40 L on the T50, 70 L on the T70P and 100 L on the T100 — bigger tanks, fewer refills.

Radar, terrain follow, wide swaths

Phased-array radar and vision sensing with terrain following on slopes up to 50°, spraying up to 40 L/min across swaths up to 13 m wide.
